correctness.rationale: For fixed m and positive a_i, the exponential-race coupling rescales the m heavy clocks to independent Exp(a_i) and ordinary clocks to a unit-rate Poisson process. Conditional on all exceptional ranks, ordinary labels are uniformly matched to M=n-m positions, so their factorial moments equal (h)_k/(M)_k with M-m<=h<=M. Uniform convergence of the conditional probability-generating function to exp(z-1) gives a Pois(1) component independent of the finite exceptional-rank correction. Conditional hypergeometric rectangle means and O(n) variances give uniform permuton. The finite Markov recursion for H_m follows by competing exponential rates 1 and a_i. Independent exact recursion gives m=2,a=(1,1) PGF (10+5z+3z^2)/18; the one-spike Bernoulli parameter is w_n/(w_n+n-1). The finite check does not replace the n-to-infinity coupling.
